label.zh: 选项b（食物换矿物）之后，待前超光速社会进入文艺复兴时代
label.en: After option b (food for minerals), once the pre-FTL society enters the Renaissance age

bridges.evidence: 3045.b sets country flag trigger_canceled_service on the pre-FTL country (events/strange_worlds_observation_events.txt:570-597); on_ftl_society_enters_new_age -> strange_worlds.3055 (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5540), trigger renaissance_age + that flag + an observation outpost (strange_worlds_observation_events.txt:672-688); 3055 fires 3060 after 180 days (693-695)

note.zh: a（秘密回收）→ 3050；b（交换）→ 日后 3060；c（灭绝型帝国）使该文明倒退一个时代，故事止。
note.en: a (covert recovery) -> 3050; b (exchange) -> 3060 later; c (homicidal) regresses the civilization one age and ends the story.

scope.zh: 我们遗留的东西：箱子的三种处理、怨恨与日后的服务终止。
scope.en: What We Left Behind: three ways to handle the crates, resentment and the later canceled service.
